# Maher Khan

> Maher Khan is an AI Content Strategist, social media strategist and digital marketer based in San Jose, California, and an Adobe Brand Ambassador for Adobe Express and Adobe Firefly. 10+ years in digital marketing. Former Assistant Professor of Marketing. Designed the Agentic AI Marketing course at UCLA Extension.

She helps hiring teams and small businesses with social media strategy, social media management, content strategy, Meta ads, Reels and video content, and AI training for marketing teams. Open to full-time Content Strategist, Senior Content Strategist, Social Media Manager and Digital Marketing roles, remote or in the San Francisco Bay Area.

## Key pages
- [Hiring portfolio](https://www.digimarketingstudio.com/hire/): case studies, results and client testimonials for recruiters
- [Services](https://www.digimarketingstudio.com/services/): social media management, Meta ads and AI marketing for small businesses
- [About Maher](https://www.digimarketingstudio.com/about/): career story from marketing professor to AI content strategist
- [Book a call](https://www.digimarketingstudio.com/book/): free 30-minute call for hiring managers and small businesses (Calendly)

## Case studies (on the hiring portfolio)
- [The Freedom Switch](https://www.digimarketingstudio.com/hire/#portfolio): 3 years and 8 months of social media and community management for a UK marketing agency and its clients (2022 to 2025)
- [UCLA Extension](https://www.digimarketingstudio.com/hire/#portfolio): Agentic AI Marketing curriculum, 15 professionals shipped AI agents
- [Maven Systems](https://www.digimarketingstudio.com/hire/#portfolio): full-funnel SaaS marketing for a bookkeeping app
- [Agency Coach](https://www.digimarketingstudio.com/hire/#portfolio): +40% engagement rate, +25% followers
